name: fantasy-command-center
description: Private ESPN fantasy football decision app with league-specific DvP, lineup, waiver, and trade analysis.

scripts.check: for file in src/*.js public/*.js extension/*.js; do node --check "$file"; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('wrangler.jsonc','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('public/manifest.webmanifest','utf8'))"
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run secret-scan

APP_ACCESS_CODE.description: Private passphrase used to open the Fantasy Command Center. Use a unique passphrase of at least 16 characters.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random session-signing secret. Generate at least 32 random bytes.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES key used to encrypt ESPN session cookies at rest.

DATA_INGEST_TOKEN.description: Random token used only by the trusted NFL dataset ingestion process. Generate at least 32 random bytes.
